value.rationale: This is a natural infinite family of equivariant topological filtrations with exact onset threshold and full integral persistence, not a one-off table entry. It provides PL fixed spaces and residual symmetry rather than character traces alone; e.g. n=18, d=3 gives six points, circles, a two-sphere wedge, a four-sphere, and a point across its last six levels, while the ambient complexes behave differently. It also identifies a structural Čech-versus-Rips parity distinction.
